summary: Generalized the block model in the shared vector/layout lane. Five of the six owned defect classes are at zero in the filtered compile sweep over all 157 owned operators (715 identities): the 354 tl.sum/tl.max/tl.min multi-axis rows (the frontend refusal removed; partial-axis reductions lower through a new staging-lane segment that materializes the reduced block -- chunked vred along the last axis, a scalar walk for other axis sets, index forms with the declared tie-break), the 139 multi-width reduce rows (the reduction runs at the operand's own SEW with per-op vsetvli regions; 16-bit float sums ride the declared fp32-lane policy with one rounding at the exit), the 15 per-chunk-partial rows (the pass splits at the first rank-0 partial consumer; the merged value binds at the pass exit), all vsetvli-region-inconsistency rows including 28 newly exposed ones (active-region tracking in the emission context; region discipline in the merge/back-edge/scalar-float/convert/maxmin/abs paths; the dot emitter's accumulator splat), and the 67 no-arange rows (scalar-only kernels and block-extent kernels lower without the legacy arange default; the default pass params come from the first real pass). 302 of the 715 owned identities now produce artifacts. The sixth class (mixed-extent runtime regions) was implemented as a segment-level restructure (group_norm_forward_affine executes PASS 12/12 at 1/4 workers) but is DISABLED after reproducing staging-path hangs under QEMU on two other shapes (a staged block carry; a masked 2-D access with a ragged row tail): the boundary keeps its located refusal with the reproductions recorded in vectorize._is_mixed_extent_region's docstring, and the restructure predicate is kept behind the switch for the repair loop that owns the staging-path defect. Of the 159 original (operator, class) pairs, 155 moved to artifacts or different-construct refusals; 4 operators (15 rows) keep the mixed-extent boundary. All pre-existing test files pass (including the ragged-tail witness, stage-barrier, IME evidence and matrix-breadth tests) and executed comparisons at 1 and 4 workers pass for the new lanes and for representative corpus operators (mean_dim fp16/bf16, reduce_kernel fp16/bf16 sums, fused_max_bincount exact int, argmin_kernel_contiguous, linalg_cross_complex).

Exit 1 comes from the sweep's partition check (5 over-budget matmul/svd compile-economics rows and 36 EmissionError 'vmath: no free caller-saved GPR pair' crashes, the math-ops emission lane's located boundary exposed by the cleared classes) and one unlocated allocation refusal; neither is one of the six owned classes.

all checks PASS including the new t028-block-forms-execute-1-4-workers check: partial-axis sum (axis=1/axis=0, fp32/fp16/bf16/int32 exact), max/argmax partial axis, the 2-D softmax composition, the multi-width reduce (fp16/bf16 data reduced at fp32), the pass-split form (a scalar atomic consumer of the reduction between block statements, int exact) and a scalar-only no-arange kernel all execute and compare PASS at 1 and 4 workers against independent numpy references; the mixed-extent form asserts the located boundary refusal.
